name: University Education System
description: University academic database with students, courses, and enrollments. Great for practicing complex JOINs and GPA calculations.

tables.name: students
tables.description: Student master data including academic standing and scholarship status

tables.name: courses
tables.description: Course catalog with credit hours and department information

tables.name: enrollments
tables.description: Student course registrations with grades and attendance tracking

relationships.description: Each enrollment belongs to one student
Each enrollment is for one course

sample_queries.title: Students with Perfect Attendance
sample_queries.description: Find students who attended 100% of classes across all enrollments
sample_queries.sql:
SELECT 
  s.student_id,
  s.student_name,
  s.major,
  COUNT(e.enrollment_id) as courses_taken,
  AVG(e.attendance_pct) as avg_attendance
FROM students s
JOIN enrollments e ON s.student_id = e.student_id
GROUP BY s.student_id, s.student_name, s.major
HAVING AVG(e.attendance_pct) = 100
ORDER BY courses_taken DESC;

sample_queries.title: Most Popular Courses by Enrollment
sample_queries.description: Courses with highest student enrollment across all terms
sample_queries.sql:
SELECT 
  c.course_name,
  c.department,
  c.credits,
  COUNT(e.enrollment_id) as total_enrollments,
  AVG(e.final_grade) as avg_grade
FROM courses c
LEFT JOIN enrollments e ON c.course_id = e.course_id
GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name, c.department, c.credits
ORDER BY total_enrollments DESC
LIMIT 10;

sample_queries.title: Scholarship Students Performance
sample_queries.description: Compare performance of scholarship vs non-scholarship students
sample_queries.sql:
SELECT 
  s.scholarship_awardee,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.student_id) as student_count,
  AVG(s.current_gpa) as avg_gpa,
  AVG(e.attendance_pct) as avg_attendance,
  AVG(e.final_grade) as avg_course_grade
FROM students s
LEFT JOIN enrollments e ON s.student_id = e.student_id
GROUP BY s.scholarship_awardee
ORDER BY avg_gpa DESC;
